slides.label: Verse 1
lines: Solo: My mind
Marvels at the extravagance of Your love

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: Choir: Your only begotten You gave as a sacrifice
To make me one with You

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: Solo: And I am dazzled by the luminescence of Your grace

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: Choir: You called me out of darkness into Your astounding light
For Your glory and Your praise

slides.label: Verse 5
lines: You delightfully reside in
The castle of my heart
Working inside me
To will and to do of Your good pleasure
You are my all in all

slides.label: Verse 6
lines: Father of glory
My life You’ve made so beautiful
Beyond all I could ask or think
Great King of glory
I’m overjoyed with thanksgiving
For Your lavish grace in me

slides.label: Verse 7
lines: Father of glory
My life You’ve made so beautiful
Beyond all I could ask or think
Great King of glory
I’m overjoyed with thanksgiving
For the gift of Your righteousness

slides.label: Verse 8
lines: Solo: My life is found in You
And centered in Your perfect will

slides.label: Verse 9
lines: Choir: This is the glory revealed in union with You
Lord, I am complete

slides.label: Verse 10
lines: Solo: Your word is the mirror and
The very essence of my being

slides.label: Verse 11
lines: Choir: Lord, as I gaze at Your word, I’m transformed into
The image of Your grand design
